create_session_recorder: create a session recorder with a unique run directory under a given runs directory
record_agent_dialog: record user and assistant messages with optional tool calls and token counts to an agent JSONL file
read_agent_dialog: read all dialog events from an agent JSONL file given a run directory and agent ID
record_pr_submitted: record when a PR is submitted for review including diff stats and revision number
finalize_session: finalize a recording session by writing a session end event with status and optional error
